raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Warner Bros. Nashville as being part of Warner Bros. Entertainment (owned by Warner Bros. Discovery) rather than being part of Warner Music Group (owned by Len Blavatnik via Access Industries). This confusion led to unnecessary exploration of Warner Bros. Discovery as a potential owner, delaying the resolution of the problem and causing confusion in the ownership chain.
